description: Sparse Iceland fuel + EV anchor POIs for P1 iceland.gasAndEvChargePlanner (seed; extend from N1/Olis/Ísorka public data).

stations.name: N1 (Keflavík / Reykjanes corridor)
stations.notes: High-traffic entry/exit; good default first/last fill.

stations.name: Ólis / N1 corridor (Selfoss area)
stations.notes: South Coast funnel — wind exposure rises southbound.

stations.name: EV hub (Hvolsvöllur / South)
stations.notes: Sparse EV vs capital; treat as planning anchor.

stations.name: South coast fuel anchor (Vík corridor)
stations.notes: Last routine ICE fill before highland / F-road exposure on many itineraries.

stations.name: Egilsstaðir services (Eastfjords gate)
stations.notes: Last major services before long east segments.

stations.name: Ísafjörður (N1 / Olís corridor — Westfjords hub)
stations.notes: Largest services cluster in NW; last reliable hybrid before deep fjord arms.

stations.name: Patreksfjörður (N1 / services — south Westfjords)
stations.notes: Fill before Látrabjarg / Rauðasandur gravel spurs; long gaps westbound.

stations.name: Hólmavík (Orkan / corridor — Westfjords gate)
stations.notes: Last routine fill leaving Ring for Strandir / Ísafjörður; bias conservative on wind days.

highlands.rationale: No routine retail fuel; specialist highland fuel only.

eastfjords_remote.rationale: Long gaps between towns on ring detours.
